datasets.verbatim: Wherein, we collected and labelled the landslide images at Ludian County and Beichuan County based on the remote sensing images from the Landsat 8.

methods.name: Dynahead-YOLO-Otsu
methods.summary: A two-stage landslide semantic segmentation method. First, it uses the Dynahead-YOLO model to detect potential landslide regions (bounding boxes). Second, it applies the Otsu binarization algorithm to these regions for pixel-wise segmentation, followed by a mean shift algorithm for noise reduction.
